confirmed_task:
Find the earliest article available on Search Engine Land. Report its publication date and author.

Stopping condition: Stop after finding the earliest available article and recording its title, publication date, and author.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not publish, edit, or comment on any article.

items.criterion: Access Search Engine Land and attempt to locate the earliest available article using on-site methods
items.description: Use Search Engine Land (starting from https://searchengineland.com/ and/or its on-site search, archives, category pages, pagination, sitemap, or other on-site navigation) to attempt to find the earliest available article. Full credit if the agent makes a reasonable on-site attempt but is prevented from proceeding or verifying the earliest article due to external blockers (e.g., site down, CAPTCHA, paywall/login wall, broken archive navigation, missing pages, inaccessible pagination) and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent’s attempt is minimal/unclear or relies primarily on off-site sources despite the site being accessible.

items.criterion: Identify the earliest available article and capture required metadata (or report inability to confirm)
items.description: Correctly identify the single earliest available article found and record its title, publication date, and author. Full credit if all three fields are correct for the earliest article the agent was able to access on the site and the agent provides a clear basis for why it is the earliest available (e.g., reached the beginning of an archive/pagination or otherwise verified no earlier accessible items). If the agent cannot conclusively determine the absolute earliest available due to external limitations (e.g., archive ends unexpectedly, oldest pages 404, date sorting unavailable), award full credit if it clearly states the limitation and reports the oldest article it could access along with its title/date/author. Partial credit if only two of the three fields are correct, if the article is on Search Engine Land but not supported as earliest/oldest accessible, or if the agent fails to explain why earlier articles could not be verified.

items.criterion: Stop after finding the earliest available article (or after reaching a clear external blocker)
items.description: Cease searching once the earliest available article has been found and its title, publication date, and author recorded, or once an external blocker clearly prevents further verification and this is reported. Partial credit if the agent continues browsing unnecessarily but still reports the correct earliest/oldest-accessible article and required metadata.
Comply with constraints by not signing in and not publishing, editing, or commenting on any article.
